oil_life_monitor: The vehicle is equipped with an oil control system that calculates engine oil and filter change intervals based on driving conditions. Severe driving conditions shorten the interval. If the oil replacement indicator is displayed, change the engine oil and filter within two weeks or less than 500 miles (800 km).

maintenance_items.notes: Oil control system calculates intervals based on driving conditions. If oil replacement indicator is displayed, change within two weeks or less than 500 miles (800 km). Shown at 10,000 mi/12 mo intervals in the schedule (20k, 30k, 40k, 50k, 60k, 70k, 80k, 90k, 100k, 110k, 120k).
Rotate tires at specified interval. Check for damage and uneven wear when rotating.

Replace at 15,000 mi/18 mo, 30,000 mi/36 mo, 45,000 mi/54 mo, 60,000 mi/72 mo, 75,000 mi/90 mo, 90,000 mi/108 mo, 105,000 mi/126 mo. When driving for prolonged periods in dusty conditions, replace more frequently.
Replace at 30,000 mi/36 mo, 60,000 mi/72 mo, 90,000 mi/108 mo. Pattern visible from provided pages.
Replace at 30,000 mi/36 mo, 60,000 mi/72 mo, 90,000 mi/108 mo, 120,000 mi/144 mo. If operating mainly in dusty conditions, more frequent maintenance may be required.

Appears at 10,000 mi (severe section at p492), 20,000 mi, 30,000 mi (severe), 40,000 mi (severe), 50,000 mi (severe), 60,000 mi, 70,000 mi, 80,000 mi, 90,000 mi (severe), 100,000 mi, 110,000 mi (severe), 120,000 mi. Replace every 60,000 miles (96,000 km) under severe conditions (car-top carrier or rough/muddy roads), or if CONSULT deterioration data exceeds 210,000.
Visually inspect for signs of leakage at specified intervals. Appears at 20,000, 30,000, 60,000, 70,000, 80,000, 90,000, 100,000, 120,000 mi in the schedule.
Replace every 20,000 miles or 24 months under severe conditions (car-top carrier or rough/muddy roads). Severe replacement shown at 20k, 60k, 80k, 120k in the schedule.

Factory-fill coolant life expectancy is 105,000 miles (168,000 km) or 7 years. Use only Genuine NISSAN Long Life Antifreeze/Coolant (blue) or equivalent. Mixing other coolant types or non-distilled water may reduce the life expectancy.

Check engine drive belt for wear, fraying or cracking and for proper tension. Replace any damaged drive belt. Formal inspection with * marking at 60,000, 70,000, 80,000, 90,000, 100,000, 120,000 mi. Also inspected as part of 'engine drive belts and hose inspections' at every interval. Marked with * — recommended by NISSAN for reliable vehicle operation but not required to maintain emission warranty.
Replace at specified intervals. Install new plugs of the type as originally equipped. Specific interval not stated in the provided pages.
Inspect only if valve noise increases. Adjust valve clearance if necessary. Marked with * — recommended by NISSAN for reliable vehicle operation.

Check vapor lines for leaks or looseness. Tighten connections or replace parts as necessary. Marked with * — recommended by NISSAN for reliable vehicle operation. Appears at 20,000/60,000/80,000/100,000/120,000 mi intervals in the schedule.

Check fuel hoses, piping and connections for leaks, looseness, or deterioration. Marked with * — recommended by NISSAN for reliable vehicle operation. Appears at 20,000/60,000/80,000/100,000/120,000 mi intervals in the schedule.

Visually inspect for proper installation. Check for chafing, cracks, deterioration, and signs of leaking. Appears at 20,000/30,000/60,000/70,000/80,000/90,000/100,000/120,000 mi intervals in the schedule.

maintenance_items.item: Brake pads, rotors, drums and linings
maintenance_items.notes: Check for wear, deterioration and fluid leaks. Replace any deteriorated or damaged parts immediately. Appears at every interval in both standard and severe schedules.
Visually inspect exhaust pipes, muffler and hangers for leaks, cracks, deterioration, and damage. Appears at every interval in both standard and severe schedules.
Check for damage, looseness, and leakage of oil or grease. Appears at every interval in both standard and severe schedules.
Check for damage, looseness, and leakage of oil or grease. Appears at every interval in both standard and severe schedules.
Check for damage and leakage of grease. Appears at every interval in both standard and severe schedules.

fluids.specification: Genuine NISSAN Motor Oil 0W-20 SP (or equivalent). If not available, synthetic 0W-20 GF-6 SP motor oil may be used. Must meet API certification or ILSAC certification and SAE viscosity standard.
fluids.capacity: 4-3/8 qt with oil filter change; 4 qt without oil filter change

fluids.specification: Pre-diluted Genuine NISSAN Long Life Antifreeze/Coolant (blue) or equivalent. 50% antifreeze / 50% water mixture. Provides antifreeze protection to -34°F (-37°C).
fluids.capacity: 1-7/8 gal with manual transmission; 1-7/8 gal with CVT (including reservoir)

fluids.specification: Genuine NISSAN Manual Transmission Fluid (MTF) TL/JR Type 75W-80, or equivalent. If not available, API GL-4+, Viscosity SAE 75W-80 may be used as a temporary replacement.
Genuine NISSAN CVT Fluid NS-3. Do not mix with other fluids.
Genuine NISSAN Brake Fluid or equivalent DOT 3
Genuine NISSAN A/C System Oil Type PAG or equivalent
Genuine NISSAN Windshield Washer Concentrate Cleaner & Antifreeze fluid or equivalent
Unleaded regular gasoline with an octane rating of at least 87 AKI (Anti-Knock Index) / Research octane number 91. Do not use E-15 or E-85.

severe_conditions: Repeated short trips of less than 5 miles (8 km)
Repeated short trips of less than 10 miles (16 km) with outside temperatures remaining below freezing
Operating in hot weather in stop-and-go 'rush hour' traffic
Extensive idling and/or low speed driving for long distances, such as police, taxi or door-to-door delivery use
Driving on rough, muddy or salt spread roads
extraction_caveats: 1. The exact mileage interval for spark plug replacement is not stated in the provided pages; the item is included with null intervals per the text's reference to 'specified intervals.' 2. Engine valve clearance has no explicit mileage interval — it is conditional ('inspect only if valve noise increases'). 3. Engine oil change interval is governed by the oil control system (condition-based); the schedule pages show replacement at every 10,000 mi/12 mo milestone. 4. Tire rotation appears at every 5,000 mi/6 mo interval based on the schedule pages. 5. The CVT fluid capacity is listed as '—' (not specified) in the fluids table on pages 508–509. 6. Manual transmission fluid capacity is listed as '—' (not specified) in the fluids table. 7. Brake fluid, multi-purpose grease, A/C refrigerant, and A/C oil capacities are listed as '—' (not specified). 8. Some maintenance items marked with '*' are recommended by NISSAN for reliable vehicle operation but are not required to maintain the emission warranty or manufacturer recall liability. 9. Brake fluid replacement intervals are complex: standard schedule shows replacement at 20k, 60k, 70k, 80k, 100k, 120k; severe schedule adds replacement at 10k, 30k, 40k, 50k, 90k, 110k. The combined pattern does not reduce to a single clean repeat interval. 10. The Intelligent Key battery replacement pattern from the provided pages shows 30k, 60k, 90k (every 30k/36 mo) but also at 75k — the 75k occurrence may be an anomaly or intentional; recorded as 30k/36 mo base interval. 11. Evaporative emissions control vapor lines (fuel tank vapor vent system) inspection appears at 20k, 60k, 80k, 100k, 120k — not a clean repeat interval.
